sections.title: BNS Section 101: Criminal Complaints
sections.content: This section outlines the procedures for filing criminal complaints with the appropriate authorities. It includes information about the required format, the necessary signatories, and the timeline for processing such complaints.

sections.title: BNS Section 204: Evidence Collection
sections.content: Details the proper methods for evidence collection at crime scenes, including documentation requirements, chain of custody procedures, and preservation techniques.

sections.title: BNS Section 315: Witness Statements
sections.content: Guidelines for recording witness statements, including format requirements, verification procedures, and recording of demographic information of witnesses.

sections.title: BNS Section 422: Preliminary Investigation
sections.content: Procedures for conducting preliminary investigations, including scene examination, interviewing relevant parties, and initial evidence assessment prior to formal investigation.

sections.title: BNS Section 503: Property Theft
sections.content: This section deals with offenses related to theft of property. It outlines the elements of theft, different categories based on property value, and corresponding penalties for offenders.

sections.title: BNS Section 621: Assault and Battery
sections.content: Covers criminal offenses related to physical assault, battery, and causing bodily harm to others. Includes definitions, categories based on severity, and applicable punishments.

sections.title: BNS Section 708: Fraud and Deception
sections.content: This section addresses various types of fraud, including financial fraud, identity theft, and deceptive practices. It details the elements of fraud offenses and their penalties.

sections.title: BNS Section 845: Criminal Trespass
sections.content: Defines criminal trespass, including entering private property without permission, remaining after being asked to leave, and aggravating factors such as carrying weapons during trespass.
